result.instructions: Each tool runs one installed audit tool with --audit-json and returns its audit-result/1 object. exit 1 means findings, not a failure. Cite rule, path, line and commit from evidence.

tools.description: The six audit tools, whether each is installed, its version and the minimum version with --audit-json.
tools.name: list_audit_tools

tools.description: suite-gate: one verdict (pass, warn, fail or error) for ref against base, from the built-in rules: git-surface always, trust-path when workflows changed, release-drift for each changed lockfile (queries registries), git-overlap against the other local branches. Returns every tool's audit result with its evidence.

forge.description: Whose workflow rules trust-path applies (default github; gitea and forgejo need trust-path 0.9.0 or later)

tools.name: gate

tools.description: git-surface: what each ref changes, since its merge base with base, that runs or is trusted (CI, hooks, agent files, install scripts, dependencies, hidden text).

refs.description: Branch, tag or commit names to check

tools.name: git_surface

tools.description: git-overlap: pairs of refs that change the same path since base (git footprint, then git overlap). Optional 'with' keeps only pairs that include that ref.

refs.description: Branch, tag or commit names to check

with.description: Only pairs that include this ref

tools.name: git_overlap

tools.description: git-overlap: whether each pair of refs merges (git pairmerge, in memory). Optional 'onto' merges each pair as both would land on that base.
tools.name: git_pairmerge

tools.description: trust-path: paths by which untrusted input reaches a secret, write permission, OIDC token, environment or AI agent action in GitHub Actions workflows (Gitea and Forgejo with forge).

forge.description: Whose workflow rules trust-path applies (default github; gitea and forgejo need trust-path 0.9.0 or later)

ref.description: Read the workflows from git at this ref instead of the files

tools.name: trust_path

tools.description: release-drift: what a new release artifact adds over an old one (install scripts, start-up hooks, native code, new dependencies, URL hosts, encoded strings).

old.description: Old artifact file (.whl, sdist or npm .tgz)

tools.name: release_drift_diff

tools.description: release-drift: files of a release artifact that are not, as they are, in git at ref.

ref.description: Tag or commit the release was built from

tools.name: release_drift_source

tools.description: release-drift: every package a lockfile change upgrades, downloaded from its registry and compared as release_drift_diff does.
tools.name: release_drift_lockfile

tools.description: release-drift: whether a new version was published differently from the old one (provenance removed, workflow changed, another npm account).
tools.name: release_drift_provenance

tools.description: pr-merge-audit: the findings of a merge-test results file (which PRs merged, conflicted or failed their tests).

results.description: Results file written by pr-merge-audit build

tools.name: pr_merge_audit_report

tools.description: glassbox: which sensitive locations (credentials, private data) a process started here could read. Opens each location read-only; never reads contents.

since.description: An earlier `glassbox reach --json` report to compare with

tools.name: glassbox_reach

tools.description: glassbox: persistence points (launch agents, shell startup, git hooks, agent configs) added, changed or removed since a snapshot saved with `glassbox persist --save`.

repos.description: Repositories whose hooks and configs to include

tools.name: glassbox_persist
